approximation: Tree-level MadWidth through 2-body decays; 1% adaptive target. Reported modes require BR ≥ 1e-08, without renormalizing their BRs or total widths. Unknown adaptive/body tails remain; total-width accuracy is not guaranteed.
coverage_notices: x > s ve: retained perturbative partial width 0.0182534 GeV below the QCD scale; hadronization may matter.
Reported decay rows omit modes below min_br; omitted_probability records their summed BR for each parent. The SLHA card and total widths retain those modes.
Adaptive precision and the maximum body multiplicity can leave uncomputed contributions. Their probability is unknown; reported BRs use the computed total, not a guaranteed physical total.
